text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali decides several measures in favour of cinema showroom tenants.
- Habib Boulares reelected speaker of parliament.

- Tunisian magistrate Noureddine Ben Ayed arrived in Liege, Belgium for contacts with Belgian investigators over the case of two Tunisian men accused of killing Belgian socialist politican Andre Cools.
